decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

External Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
description:
DEMOLITION OF AN EXISTING CONSERVATORY TO ERECT A
SINGLE-STOREY GROUND-FLOOR REAR EXTENSION, CONVERSION OF GARAGE INTO A
HABITABLE ROOM INCLUDING REPLACING THE GARAGE DOOR WITH 2 x WINDOW OPENINGS,
AND A LOFT CONVERSION TO INCLUDE 2 x ROOF BALCONY WINDOWS AND SOLAR PANELS.
